notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.04

- CHAPTER 2 "Halloween Fun" available.
- Fixed crashes in colliders of some opponents.
- Fixed crashes in colliders of picked up items.
- The scope of the Mech9000 weapon has been expanded.
- Noticeably strengthened opponents in CHAPTER 2
- Added a Boss battle.
- Added new memes and references.

notes.title: Angry Troll Simulator Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Update 1.02

- Сharacter's in-flyght body controll added
- Main camera "view through textures" issue fixed
- Melee battle system collider glitches fixed
- Added Full HD resolution 1920x1080
- UI text fonts are adapted to Full HD resolution
- Reduced camera's far view for better FPS rate
- Zombie attack script glitch fixed
- Cave crystals light level reduced to optimal level
